donation.paragraph1: Thank you for spending your time with KanaDojo. We are honored to be a part of your Japanese learning journey.
donation.paragraph2: If KanaDojo has been helpful to you, we would be incredibly grateful if you ever considered supporting it with a donation.
donation.paragraph3: From day one, we have cared deeply about keeping this a fully free, accessible and open-source learning resource for everyone — and we are wholeheartedly committed to keeping it that way forever.
donation.paragraph4: We appreciate you more than we can properly express, and thank you again for being part of this project and for any support you can offer.
donation.title: A small favor, if you can
